# SAMPLE-0 — a sample of the shape a convergence rule text takes

This file is a test fixture. It shows the SHAPE of a rule text under a sample id; it is not a rule and nothing
cites it. The real rule is `skills/_meta/convergence-rule.md`.

## Applicability

The rule applies only when all three answers are "yes".

1. Do the candidates fill the same slot?
2. Is exactly one output wanted?
3. Does at least one candidate clear the bar?

## The eligible winner

The winner must be an eligible candidate: one that passes the blocking checks, or one selected for repair and
re-checked before the award is confirmed.

## Borrowed parts

A borrow is a named part, re-made by the winner.

## Exclusions

| When | Instead |
|---|---|
| a sample case the rule does not cover | a sample of what to do instead |
| no candidate clears the bar | `no_award` |
